title: TranscriptIn
description: What the pipeline ingests: the sponsor's canonical transcript schema 1.0 (Sponsor Deliverables v1.2 s8), plus our optional is_mock. Turns are raw; the scorer builds volleys. See docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md.

session_id.description: Neutral number, shuffled; never a persona id.

is_mock.description: Team field, not in the sponsor schema. true on every invented file; read as false when missing.

provenance.description: Staff calls on Aven are internal_test. Simulated conversations are never used (Amendment 1 s4).

source.description: deliv s8 names the first three; other is ours, for text pasted into the scorer page.

aven_version.description: Agent and flow version, e.g. v21; null for corpora.

target_behavior.description: For corpora, the topic column; for Aven, the same as the goal or the focus area.

text.description: The designated goal as a behavior.

start_ms.description: From Retell's word timings; null for text.

node.description: The Aven node active during the turn (deliv s9); null for corpora.

event.description: Node transitions and tool calls, tied to the turn before which they happened. Metadata, never coded. Our files always write from, to and name (null when unused); the sponsor's may omit them.
